$meta.name: Equal AI Design System
$meta.notes: Single source of truth. Run `npm run tokens` to regenerate web (CSS + TS) and Compose (Kotlin) outputs. Tokens flagged "proposed": true are NOT in the colour guide; they were derived from the component references / typography inventory and need designer sign-off. Dark values are implemented exactly as written in the Alias Tokens design.

motion.$source: Monetization prototype (Figma): Switch 500ms ease-in-out; Coupon spring 590ms after 300ms; Pricing / Coupon Pricing 600ms after 800ms; Shimmer 600ms after 1.2s; Button Glow 300ms after 800ms; Payment Status 1022ms gentle after 2.4s; Reward Animation 6s linear.
